title: Mallangable Extension Manifest
description: Declares what one extension (artifact) does, where, and with which capabilities. The runtime allows no behavior outside this declaration (spec 2.4, 5.3, 5.9).

feature.description: Id of the feature this extension belongs to

entry.description: Artifact entry file (a data file if declarative)

catalog_id.description: Catalog the D3 artifact assumes. Rejected at G1 if it differs from the capability map's catalog_id (cross-document check, verified by the conformance validator)

content_hash.description: Pins the content on share and install (spec 7.7)

points.description: Ids of the extension points touched

permissions.description: Required capability ids. The broker denies them until approved (I4)

allow.description: List of allowed hosts. IP literals (e.g. 169.254.169.254) are rejected by the pattern (the last label starts with a letter). Public-suffix wildcards (e.g. *.co.uk) cannot be blocked by the schema, so the conformance validator MUST reject them using the Public Suffix List. Empty means no external communication. A value that opens every host, such as a bare '*', is not an allowlist and is rejected (only subdomain wildcards like '*.example.com' are allowed). If non-empty, permissions MUST include a capability with risk=egress. The schema only checks that permissions is non-empty; whether it is egress MUST be checked by the conformance validator, which reads the capability map

host_api.description: Compatible capability map version range (semver range)

migrate_from.description: Previous schema versions supported for state handover (spec 5.9)

label.description: Lexicon pack id of the 'feature I added' marker text shown on screen

allOf.description: Opening external communication requires a requested capability (I4). Whether that capability is egress is checked by the conformance validator
Code artifacts must declare a state handover spec (state.schema_version) for hot swap (5.9). Whether migrate_from is sufficient across versions is checked by the conformance validator
D1~D3 are declarative (2.6, rule L3). A code artifact (sandboxed, native) must be declared D4 or higher
D4 is code inside a sandbox (2.6). native is only for D5 core forks (chapter 3, A2)
